title: When the Uniform Sings
author: Ines Underhill
blurb: Oscar Sandoval, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
